subject: Business Models
title: The Innovator's Dilemma
description: A quick win: understand The Innovator's Dilemma.

hook.text: Clayton Christensen showed why great companies fail: they listen to existing customers instead of future ones.

buildup.text: Established companies optimize for current customers who want better versions of today's products.

discovery.text: Disruptors start with worse products for overlooked customers, then improve until they steal the mainstream market.

twist.text: Kodak, Blockbuster, Nokia—each dominated and each was disrupted by initially inferior products they dismissed.

climax.text: The dilemma: serving today's best customers optimally blinds you to tomorrow's disruptive threats.

punchline.text: Listening to your best customers can kill you. The innovator's dilemma is real.

quiz.question: What is the core of the innovator's dilemma?
options: Serving current customers well blinds companies to disruptive threats
